errorRules.message: Nebius Token Factory returned HTTP 401. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}
Nebius Token Factory returned HTTP 402 (Payment Required): the account budget is exhausted. Billing details: https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/other-capabilities/billing-new
Nebius Token Factory returned HTTP 404: the model '{model}' does not exist. Model ids are listed at https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/model-catalog.md

Nebius Token Factory returned HTTP 429 (rate limit exceeded). The Retry-After response header gives the time in seconds to wait before making another request (https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/ai-models-inference/rate-limits)

instructions: 1. Visit: https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/ and create an account; the quickstart (https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/quickstart) says: "Log in using your Google or GitHub account"

2. Create an API key (https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/api-reference/introduction#authentication): go to the API keys section, click Create API key, enter the key name, click Create, and save the displayed key — "Save the displayed API key. You cannot open it later in Nebius Token Factory."

3. Billing (https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/other-capabilities/billing-new): "Billing setup is mandatory—you cannot complete onboarding without it." "Setting up a billing account requires a bank card." "Upon first sign-up, you receive $1 in trial credit, valid for 30 days."
4. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (the vendor's docs read NEBIUS_API_KEY)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1 (https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/api-reference/introduction: "Nebius Token Factory offers an OpenAI-compatible API for inference and fine-tuning."). Docs-verified, not live-verified: an unauthenticated GET of https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/models answers HTTP 401 without a key, so the model ids come from the vendor's public model catalog (https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/api/public/models_info, retrieved 2026-09-29) and the roster has not been checked against the API. errorRules follow the statuses and example bodies in https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/api-reference/inference/create-chat-completion (401, 402, 404, 429). models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (8192) is the value that reference gives for an omitted max_tokens ("If omitted or set to null, defaults to 8192 tokens."); models.defaultContextWindow (32000) is a placeholder the vendor does not publish.
